SCENE CONTEXT
Continue exactly from the start image: two-shot in a bright cafe by a window, round marble table. The woman sits on the left (ivory chunky knit cardigan over a white t-shirt, thin gold round glasses, neat low ponytail, small gold hoop earrings). The man sits on the right (navy crew-neck knit, black square glasses, short two-block hair) holding up a white smartphone in his right hand, its back toward the camera, screen toward the two of them. Both are looking at his phone. Iced americano on the left, iced latte on the right.

FORMAT MODE
One continuous shot, no cuts.

CAMERA
A friend at the next table films on a smartphone held vertically, eye level, 50mm look, two-shot. Light natural handheld sway of 2 to 4 cm, no zoom, no pan. Modern phone video: clean, natural colors, no over-sharpening, no film grain.

ACTION
0.0s to 2.2s: the man tilts the phone a little toward her and says the line, counting four on the fingers of his free hand, then glances at her on the last words.
2.2s to 3.0s: she looks at the screen and nods once with a bright little smile; he lowers the phone slightly.

PERFORMANCE
Small expression changes, realistic, no exaggerated acting, no look at the camera. The man speaks natural native Korean, matter-of-fact, a little proud.

AUDIO
Quiet cafe ambience. No music, no vibration.

POSITIVE LOCKS
Both keep the same faces, hair, glasses and clothes through the whole take. She stays on the left, he stays on the right, same seating, same cafe background. Only one phone in frame, held in his right hand, its back toward the camera. The woman does not speak. No subtitles, no on-screen text.

DIALOGUE
The man says in Korean: "우리는 엄마, 아빠, 나, 동생 4명이야. 들어왔지?" Natural conversational delivery at normal pace, mouth movements match the words, no subtitles, no on-screen text.
